common_support_rule: A candidate whose first unsupported Return state is u_k has H_sup=u_k-1; H_eff=min_k H_sup(k), and H_eff=0 is OBJECTIVE_UNSCOREABLE.
formula_limitations: Current causal flow audit does not prove end-to-end remaining across completed hops for all Input/Return flows.
Route revision and superseded Epoch identity are not fully runtime-source-backed.
DepData transfer is absent in the audited simulator runtime.

verified_semantics.identity: flow identity, FlowType, Epoch/RouteRevision and current holder are required for a stable burden calculation; current route revision is model state/action-side revision
verified_semantics.intermediate_hop: hop_remaining decreases and current_hop_index advances; flow_remaining does not decrease
verified_semantics.reroute: recompute from predicted route/hop state only when identity and route revision remain supported
verified_semantics.terminal_hop: e2e delivered reduces flow_remaining; completed Flow loses presence/carrying
verified_semantics.unknown_padded: exclude; never use padding as service support
